Name: Amminadab, Chief of Uzziel
Summary: Chief of the sons of Uzziel who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and twelve.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 15:10; 1 Chronicles 15:11: Chief of the sons of Uzziel who brought up the ark, with his brethren an hundred and twelve.
LifeLesson: The mention of Amminadab in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
